desktop.installStep3.en: Sign in to chat immediately with official models, or switch to your own key and connect agents (MCP / CLI)
desktop.installStep3.zh: 启动后登录账号即可直接问答（开箱自带官方模型），亦可按需切换自备 Key 或连接桌面 Agent (MCP / CLI)

desktop.licensesSubtitle.en: Manage Context-OS licenses and activated devices
desktop.licensesSubtitle.zh: 管理 Context-OS 授权与已激活设备

desktop.needClientHint.en: Don't have the client yet? Download it before activating.
desktop.needClientHint.zh: 尚未安装客户端？请先下载再激活。

desktop.portableHint.en: Portable EXE: run after download (keep a stable folder).
desktop.portableHint.zh: 当前为便携版 EXE：下载后直接运行即可（建议固定安装目录）。

desktop.productSubtitle.en: Private by default, official models out of the box or BYOK, callable by Claude / Codex via MCP / CLI. 100% free with no license fee.
desktop.productSubtitle.zh: 数据本地私有，开箱即用官方模型或配置自备 Key，可被 Claude / Codex 等桌面 Agent 以 MCP / CLI 调用。完全免费，无需买断许可。

desktop.productTitle.en: AI knowledge base desktop client · free
desktop.productTitle.zh: AI 知识库桌面客户端 · 完全免费

desktop.signedHint.en: Installer is Authenticode-signed. SmartScreen may still warn for new/self-signed publishers — use Run anyway if needed.
desktop.signedHint.zh: 安装包已 Authenticode 签名。若仍见 SmartScreen，选择「仍要运行」（自签/新发布者需积累信誉）。

desktop.smartScreenHint.en: If SmartScreen warns about an unknown app, choose Run anyway (normal until publisher reputation builds).
desktop.smartScreenHint.zh: 若 SmartScreen 提示未知应用，选择「仍要运行」（正式签名信誉积累前属正常现象）。

desktop.unsignedHint.en: Installer is not yet signed with a commercial code-signing certificate; SmartScreen may warn.
desktop.unsignedHint.zh: 安装包尚未使用商业代码签名证书；SmartScreen 可能提示未知发布者。

desktopBuy.freeBody.en: The desktop client is free to download and use. Cloud models still use wallet top-up or a membership plan.
desktopBuy.freeBody.zh: 根据最新 ADR-0010 规范，Context-OS 桌面客户端已面向所有用户免费开放下载与连接，无需额外激活授权卡。云端高级模型服务可通过按量充值或订阅 Pro 会员解锁。

desktopBuy.subtitle.en: Native desktop app with local or private compute
desktopBuy.subtitle.zh: 独立桌面版本，原生流畅体验，支持本地或私有算力

desktopBuy.title.zh: Context-OS 桌面客户端购买与授权

desktopBuy.upgradeCta.zh: 升级云端会员 / 充值 →

helpApiAccessAutomationBody.en: Scripts and coding agents should use a workspace API key with MCP. On the desktop client, context-os-mcp (stdio) forwards to 127.0.0.1:18080; HTTP POST /api/v1/mcp also works. Copy snippets from workspace API Access → For agents.
helpApiAccessAutomationBody.zh: 脚本与 coding agent 请用工作区 API 密钥调用 MCP。本机客户端可用 context-os-mcp（stdio）转发到 127.0.0.1:18080；也可用 HTTP POST /api/v1/mcp。配置片段在工作区 API Access「给 Agent 用」。

helpApiAccessAutomationStep1.en: Create a workspace in the UI, open API Access on that workspace, and mint a key with index/query.
helpApiAccessAutomationStep1.zh: 在产品 UI 创建 Workspace，打开该工作区的 API Access，创建带 index/query 的密钥。

helpApiAccessAutomationStep2.en: Desktop: build or stage context-os (includes context-os-mcp), set CONTEXT_OS_API_KEY, then run context-os status.
helpApiAccessAutomationStep2.zh: 本机客户端：构建或 stage context-os（含 context-os-mcp），设置 CONTEXT_OS_API_KEY 后运行 context-os status。

helpApiAccessAutomationStep3.en: Agents use stdio MCP (command = context-os-mcp); scripts can use context-os ingest/ask; always pass workspace_id.
helpApiAccessAutomationStep3.zh: Agent 用 stdio MCP（command = context-os-mcp）；脚本可用 context-os ingest/ask；工具参数带上 workspace_id。

helpApiAccessAutomationStep4.en: Share, members, and key management stay on the signed-in user UI only.
helpApiAccessAutomationStep4.zh: 分享、成员与密钥管理仍只在用户会话 UI 中完成。

helpApiAccessSubtitle.en: API access for personal users. Each workspace has its own keys; automated agents should use the agent docs.
helpApiAccessSubtitle.zh: 面向个人用户的 API 接入说明。每个工作区单独管理密钥；自动化代理请使用 agent 文档。

helpItemAccount1.en: Registration, sign-in, password reset, and sign-out are all supported.
helpItemAccount1.zh: 支持注册、登录、重置密码与退出登录。

helpItemAccount2.en: Protected routes return to sign-in automatically when the session expires.
helpItemAccount2.zh: 登录态失效时，受保护路由会自动回到登录页。

helpItemAccount3.en: If you hit a 401 or 403, confirm the current token is still valid first.
helpItemAccount3.zh: 如果遇到 401 或 403，先确认当前 token 是否仍然有效。

helpItemApi1.en: Each workspace can create and revoke its own API keys.
helpItemApi1.zh: 每个工作区可以单独创建和撤销 API 密钥。

helpItemApi2.en: API Access shows scopes, rate limits, and one-time plaintext key reveal.
helpItemApi2.zh: 当前 API Access 页面提供权限、速率限制和一次性明文 key 展示。

helpItemApi3.en: Workspace API keys only cover uploads, URL imports, and knowledge-base queries for that workspace. Create the workspace in the app first, then mint a key here.
helpItemApi3.zh: 工作区 API 密钥只用于该工作区的资料上传、URL 导入和知识库查询；先在应用里创建工作区，再在此页创建密钥。

helpItemApiAgentDocs.zh: 打开 Agent API 文档

helpItemApiHumanDocs.en: Open the human developer API docs
helpItemApiHumanDocs.zh: 打开人类开发者 API 文档

helpItemCollab1.en: Share Center covers access levels, share links, member invites, and access logs.
helpItemCollab1.zh: Share Center 支持访问级别、分享链接、成员邀请和访问日志。

helpItemCollab2.en: Public share links open a read-only shared workspace page.
helpItemCollab2.zh: 公开分享链接会落到只读的 shared workspace 页面。

helpItemCollab3.en: Invite flows let signed-out users sign in or register before accepting access.
helpItemCollab3.zh: 邀请页支持未登录用户先登录或注册，再继续接受邀请。

helpItemDesktop1.en: The Windows client is free. Data can stay local; MCP / CLI work with desktop agents.
helpItemDesktop1.zh: Windows 客户端完全免费下载使用；数据可留在本机，支持 MCP / CLI 供桌面 Agent 调用。

helpItemDesktop2.en: Sign in after installation to chat immediately with official models, or configure your own keys; use Run anyway if SmartScreen warns.
helpItemDesktop2.zh: 安装后登录账号即可直接问答（开箱自带官方模型），亦支持配置自备 Key；SmartScreen 提示时选择仍要运行。

helpItemDesktopBuy.zh: 历史授权记录（非主路径）

helpItemDesktopDownload.zh: 下载 / 了解客户端（免费）

helpItemDocs1.en: You can upload files and add URL-based sources.
helpItemDocs1.zh: 支持上传文件和添加 URL 资料源。

helpItemDocs2.en: Sessions can limit retrieval to selected documents, which shapes what the knowledge base can cite.
helpItemDocs2.zh: 会话可以按资料勾选限定检索范围，直接影响知识库回答所用的文档。

helpItemDocs3.en: If source state looks wrong, reindex it and watch status changes in the right rail.
helpItemDocs3.zh: 资料状态异常时可以执行重建索引，并在右侧面板观察状态变化。

helpItemTroubleshooting1.en: If share pages are empty, confirm sharing is enabled. Desktop local libraries must publish to the cloud first.
helpItemTroubleshooting1.zh: 分享页没有数据时，先确认该工作区是否已经启用分享链接。桌面本机库需先「发布到云端」再开分享。

helpItemTroubleshooting2.en: If API calls fail, check the key is still active, unexpired, and targeting the correct workspace path.
helpItemTroubleshooting2.zh: API 调用失败时，先确认密钥仍处于生效状态、没有过期，且命中了正确的 workspace 路径。

helpItemTroubleshooting3.en: If UI copy or state looks inconsistent, verify you are not still on a compatibility redirect path.
helpItemTroubleshooting3.zh: 界面文案或状态不一致时，优先检查当前路由是否仍停留在兼容跳转链路上。

helpItemWorkspace1.en: Each workspace contains history on the left, chat in the middle, and sources plus notes on the right.
helpItemWorkspace1.zh: 每个工作区包含左侧历史、中间对话区，以及右侧资料和笔记面板。

helpItemWorkspace2.en: The history list supports filtering, and opening a thread restores its messages.
helpItemWorkspace2.zh: 历史列表支持关键词过滤；点击已有线程会恢复对应会话消息。

helpItemWorkspace3.en: The top bar now provides Share, API Access, and New Workspace shortcuts; account settings live in the account menu on the right.
helpItemWorkspace3.zh: 顶栏现在提供分享、API Access 和新建工作区快捷入口，账户相关设置收进右侧账户菜单。

helpItemWrite1.en: Enter a topic to auto-research, outline, and draft a long-form article in sections.
helpItemWrite1.zh: 输入主题后自动调研、生成大纲并分段撰写长文。

helpItemWrite2.en: Includes statistical-fingerprint refinement to reduce detectable AI patterns.
helpItemWrite2.zh: 支持统计指纹精修，降低 AI 生成痕迹。

helpItemWrite3.en: Falls back to single-path research when one research path fails.
helpItemWrite3.zh: 单路调研失败时会自动降级为单路模式。

helpItemWriteDocs.zh: 查看 Write 模式文档

helpItemWriteMore.zh: 了解 Write 模式（长文自动写作）

helpSubtitle.en: A wiki-style guide to Context-OS core workflows, API boundaries, and the first troubleshooting path to check.
helpSubtitle.zh: 按 Wiki 方式整理 Context-OS 的核心工作流、API 能力边界，以及出现问题时的优先排查路径。

helpWriteDegradeBody.en: When quality checks are not fully satisfied, the article is still delivered (soft exit) with a validation warning. If one research path fails, it falls back to single-path.
helpWriteDegradeBody.zh: 当质量校验未全部通过时，文章仍会交付（软结束），并附带校验警告。单路调研失败时自动降级为单路。

helpWritePageSubtitle.en: Automatically writes long-form articles from a topic, with built-in research, outlining, sectioned drafting, and statistical-fingerprint refinement.
helpWritePageSubtitle.zh: 根据主题自动撰写长文，内置调研、大纲、分段写作与统计指纹精修。

home.seoBulletAgents.en: External agents (MCP / API): mint per-workspace keys and connect the knowledge base to agents like Cursor or Claude over MCP or HTTP API.
home.seoBulletAgents.zh: 外接 Agent（MCP / API）：每个工作区可单独创建密钥，通过 MCP 或 HTTP API 把知识库接到 Cursor、Claude 等 Agent。

home.seoBulletDiff.en: Unique advantage in open connectivity: differing from standalone notes, Context OS turns ingested docs into structured retrieval surfaces accessible to external agents via MCP/API, with shareable guest workspaces (see comparison guide).
home.seoBulletDiff.zh: 独特优势在于开放连接：与单机笔记或封闭知识库形成显著差异，Context OS 文档入库后即成结构化检索面，可直接通过 MCP / API 开放给外部 Agent 调用，并支持向访客分享免登录公开库（详见选型对比）。

home.seoBulletDocs.en: Docs in, answers out: upload files or paste URLs as sources; scope retrieval per workspace, with answers traceable to specific documents.
home.seoBulletDocs.zh: 文档入库与问答：上传文件或粘贴 URL 即成资料源；提问可按库限定检索范围，回答可溯源到具体文档。

home.seoBulletShare.en: Membership & share slots: start free; upgrade for more shareable slots so guests can browse public workspaces without signing in.
home.seoBulletShare.zh: 会员与分享名额：免费档即可建仓；升级会员获得更多可分享名额，访客免登录浏览公开库。

home.seoSectionDiff.zh: 核心优势与差异化定位

home.seoSubtitle.en: Turn scattered documents into a searchable, shareable, AI-citable personal AI knowledge base — ask questions yourself, or open a workspace to guests and external agents.
home.seoSubtitle.zh: 把分散的文档变成可检索、可分享、可被 AI 引用的个人 AI 知识库：自己问答，也可以把库开放给访客或外接 Agent。

home.seoTitle.en: Context OS by ContextLM — a locally deployable personal AI knowledge base
home.seoTitle.zh: Context OS（ContextLM 旗下）— 可本地部署的个人 AI 知识库

legalConsentPrefix.en: I have read and agree to the

legalReacceptanceBody.en: We updated the Terms of Service or Privacy Policy. Read and accept the latest versions before continuing.
legalReacceptanceBody.zh: 我们更新了用户服务协议或隐私政策。继续使用前，请阅读并确认最新版本。

legalReacceptanceConsentRequired.en: Read and accept the latest Terms of Service and Privacy Policy first
legalReacceptanceConsentRequired.zh: 请先阅读并同意最新版用户协议与隐私政策。

notifications.emptyBody.en: Account notifications will show up here.
notifications.emptyBody.zh: 账户通知会显示在这里。

paywall.body.en: You may have hit the free allowance, or this library feature needs a paid plan.
paywall.body.zh: 您可能已超出免费体验额度，或正在访问受限的持久知识库高级能力。升级后可立享高速专属通道。

paywall.subtitle.en: This needs a Pro plan or wallet balance
paywall.subtitle.zh: 当前功能需要 Pro 专业版或可用钱包余额

paywall.title.zh: 需升级会员以继续使用

paywallErrorLoad.en: Unable to load upgrade details. Please try again later.
paywallErrorLoad.zh: 无法加载升级信息，请稍后重试。

paywallResetHint.en: Or add a custom provider so chat does not spend platform balance
paywallResetHint.zh: 也可配置自定义 Provider，对话不再消耗平台余额。

paywallSubtitle5h.en: Without balance or a custom provider, the platform may throttle. Top up balance, add a custom provider, or upgrade share slots.
paywallSubtitle5h.zh: 余额不足且未配置自定义 Provider 时，平台会暂时限速。充值余额、配置自定义 Provider，或升级分享名额即可恢复。

paywallSubtitle7d.en: Without balance or a custom provider, the platform may throttle. Top up balance, add a custom provider, or upgrade share slots.
paywallSubtitle7d.zh: 余额不足且未配置自定义 Provider 时，平台会暂时限速。充值余额、配置自定义 Provider，或升级分享名额即可恢复。

pricing.agreeLabel.en: I have read and agree to the terms of service and payment terms
pricing.agreeLabel.zh: 我已阅读并同意用户服务协议与付款说明

pricing.agreeRequired.en: Accept the terms before topping up.
pricing.agreeRequired.zh: 请先同意服务条款后再充值。

pricing.fallbackFreeDesc.en: Personal Q&A and a light start
pricing.fallbackFreeDesc.zh: 适合个人基础问答与轻量体验

pricing.fallbackProDesc.en: Deep libraries, persistent sources, and faster agents
pricing.fallbackProDesc.zh: 深度知识库构建、无限持久资料与高速 Agent

pricing.faqAnytimeAnswer.en: Yes. Credit is available as soon as payment completes.
pricing.faqAnytimeAnswer.zh: 可以。充值完成后余额立即到账。

pricing.faqBalanceAnswer.en: Platform model calls, document parse, and web search debit the wallet.
pricing.faqBalanceAnswer.zh: 平台模型推理、文档解析与网络搜索按量扣费。

pricing.payHint.en: Complete payment with the selected method.
pricing.payHint.zh: 请使用所选支付方式完成付款。

pricing.plansFallback.en: Plans are temporarily unavailable. Showing product copy.
pricing.plansFallback.zh: 套餐接口暂时不可用，以下为营销说明。

pricingFaqResetAnswer.en: On shared workspaces, the workspace owner pays model costs. Configure a custom provider in Settings if needed.
pricingFaqResetAnswer.zh: 分享问答的成本由工作区所有者承担。可在设置中配置自定义 Provider。

pricingFaqTokenAnswer.en: Primary product is shareable workspace slots (Free 3 / Plus 10 / Pro 100). The client and private workspaces are free.
pricingFaqTokenAnswer.zh: 主商品是可分享工作区名额（Free 3 / Plus 10 / Pro 100）。客户端与仅自己使用的工作区免费。

pricingFaqTopup.zh: 充值和会员有什么区别？

pricingFaqTopupAnswer.en: Membership controls share slots; top-up is the model wallet. Buy either independently. Upgrade tiers above; top up with packs below on this page.
pricingFaqTopupAnswer.zh: 会员控制可分享工作区名额；充值是模型调用余额。两者可单独购买。本页上方升级档位，下方可直接选套餐包充值。

pricingFaqUpgradeAnswer.en: Effective immediately after payment. Downgrade at end of billing cycle.
pricingFaqUpgradeAnswer.zh: 支付成功后立即生效。降级在当前计费周期结束时生效。

pricingMembershipLead.en: Pick a tier and check out here. You are buying concurrent shareable workspace slots.
pricingMembershipLead.zh: 选择档位后在本页完成支付。主商品是可同时开启分享的工作区数量。

pricingMembershipTitle.zh: 会员档位 · 可分享工作区

pricingPlanFreeDescription.en: Client and private workspaces free; 3 shareable workspaces.
pricingPlanFreeDescription.zh: 客户端与私有工作区免费；可分享工作区 3 个。

pricingPlanPlusDescription.zh: 可分享工作区 10 个，适合团队对外协作。

pricingPlanProDescription.zh: 可分享工作区 100 个，适合规模化知识服务。

pricingSubtitle.en: Client free · private use free. Membership unlocks share slots; platform models use wallet top-up.
pricingSubtitle.zh: 客户端免费 · 私有使用免费。会员解锁可分享名额；平台模型调用另用余额充值。

pricingTopupBody.en: Wallet is independent of plan. Platform models, retrieval, and shared guest Q&A (billed to the workspace owner) debit the wallet. With a custom provider, the final answer uses your quota; document indexing, the retrieval worker (Qwen3.7 Flash), and embeddings still debit the wallet.
pricingTopupBody.zh: 余额与会员独立。使用平台模型、向量检索，以及分享页访客问答（所有者付费）时从余额扣费。已配置自定义 Provider 时，最终回答走你自己的额度；文档索引、检索子代理（Qwen3.7 Flash）与向量检索仍从余额扣费。

pricingTopupCreemHint.en: Credit is CNY-denominated; Creem charges in USD — exact amount shown at checkout.
pricingTopupCreemHint.zh: 充值额度以人民币计价；Creem 渠道按美元结算，金额以收银台显示为准。

pricingTopupLoginHint.en: If you are signed out, top-up sends you to log in, then back here.
pricingTopupLoginHint.zh: 未登录时点击充值会先进入登录，完成后回到本页。

pricingTopupPoint1.en: Pick a pack on the right; top up here after sign-in
pricingTopupPoint1.zh: 在本页右侧选择套餐包，登录后可直接支付充值

pricingTopupPoint2.en: Prefer your own key for answers: configure a provider to cut chat billing (indexing and the retrieval worker still use Qwen3.7 Flash)
pricingTopupPoint2.zh: 不想用平台模型写回答：可改配自备 Key，减少对话扣费（文档索引与检索子代理仍走 Qwen3.7 Flash）

pricingTopupPoint3.en: Upgrade-only adds share slots; platform models still need wallet or BYOK
pricingTopupPoint3.zh: 只升级会员不充值：分享名额增加，但平台模型仍需余额或 BYOK

pricingTopupTitle.zh: 充值 · 模型调用余额

productGuide.billing.memberBody.en: Primary product is shareable workspace slots. Client and private workspaces stay free. Upgrading means more concurrent public shares.
productGuide.billing.memberBody.zh: 主商品是可分享工作区名额。客户端与仅自己使用的工作区不收费。升级会员 = 能同时对外分享更多库。

productGuide.billing.title.zh: 会员是干什么的 · 充值是干什么的

productGuide.billing.topupBody.en: Wallet pays platform model calls and metered retrieval. Independent of plan — top up with packs on the pricing page, or upgrade only.
productGuide.billing.topupBody.zh: 余额用于平台模型调用与向量检索等计量能力。与会员档位独立：在定价页选套餐包即可充值，也可以只升级不充值。

productGuide.client.body.en: The client is free: data can stay local, with MCP / CLI for desktop agents (Claude Code, Codex, …). Public sharing requires publish-to-cloud (vector import, no re-ingest), then cloud share slots.
productGuide.client.body.zh: 客户端完全免费：数据默认可留在本机，支持 MCP / CLI，可被 Claude Code、Codex 等桌面 Agent 调用。对外分享需先发布到云端（向量导入、不重灌库），再使用云端名额。

productGuide.graph.hint.en: Modules cross-link; continue from any entry.
productGuide.graph.hint.zh: 模块之间互相引用；从任一入口继续深入。

productGuide.llm.byokBody.en: Add your own API keys under Settings → Providers. The final answer uses your quota. Qwen3.7 Flash is the fast model for both document indexing and the retrieval worker.
productGuide.llm.byokBody.zh: 在设置 → 模型服务商中填入你自己的 API Key（如 DeepSeek / 百炼 / SiliconFlow）。最终回答走你自己的额度。Qwen3.7 Flash 作为快速模型，同时用于文档索引和检索子代理。

productGuide.llm.platformBody.en: Platform models debit your wallet. Guest Q&A on shared pages is billed to the workspace owner. Top up on the pricing page.
productGuide.llm.platformBody.zh: 使用平台模型时从余额扣费。访客在分享页提问时默认由工作区所有者承担。可在定价页直接充值。

productGuide.llm.platformTitle.zh: 平台代购 · 余额扣费

productGuide.openHint.en: How the product fits together (not primary nav)
productGuide.openHint.zh: 产品说明与模块关系（非主导航）

productGuide.overview.body.en: Workspaces are the hub: upload → index → Q&A; enable share when you publish. The desktop client exposes the same stack to agents via MCP / CLI.
productGuide.overview.body.zh: Context-OS 以工作区为中心：上传文档 → 索引 → 问答；需要对外时再开启分享。本地客户端可把同一能力接到桌面 Agent（MCP / CLI）。

productGuide.overview.step1.en: Create or open a workspace on the dashboard
productGuide.overview.step1.zh: 在工作台新建或打开一个工作区

productGuide.overview.step2.en: Configure LLM (BYOK or platform) then upload docs
productGuide.overview.step2.zh: 配置 LLM（BYOK 或平台额度）后上传文档

productGuide.overview.step3.en: Chat in the workspace; turn on share for public Q&A
productGuide.overview.step3.zh: 在对话里提问；需要对外时打开分享与访客问答

productGuide.settings.body.en: Account, preferences, billing, security, and notifications live in Settings — plus providers, usage, and referrals.
productGuide.settings.body.zh: 账户、偏好、账单、安全与通知集中在设置。模型服务商、用量与邀请奖励也在这里管理。

productGuide.share.body.en: Enable share so guests can browse or ask. Plans limit how many workspaces can be shared at once (Free 3 / Plus 10 / Pro 100), not total workspaces. Manage data, visitors, and trends in Share center and Analytics.
productGuide.share.body.zh: 在工作区开启分享后，访客可浏览或提问。档位限制的是「可同时开启分享的工作区数量」（Free 3 / Plus 10 / Pro 100），不是工作区总数。数据管理、访客与趋势见工作区内分享中心与数据分析。

productGuide.share.title.zh: 分享 · 设置 · 场景

productGuide.share.useCases.en: Common uses: public KB, team handbooks, product FAQ, public research notes.
productGuide.share.useCases.zh: 常见场景：对外知识库、团队说明页、产品 FAQ、研究笔记公开副本。

productGuide.subtitle.en: Modules linked like a knowledge graph: LLM, workspaces, share, client, billing. Use the left topics or linked entries.
productGuide.subtitle.zh: 像知识图谱一样串联各模块：LLM、工作区、分享、客户端与计费。点左侧主题或下方链接即可跳转。

productGuide.workspace.body.en: Each workspace is an isolated knowledge base: sources, notes, chat, and share state do not cross. The source count on a card is how many docs are attached.
productGuide.workspace.body.zh: 每个工作区是一套独立知识库：来源、笔记、对话与分享状态互不串线。卡片上的「来源数」表示已接入文档量。

progress.final_check_degraded.en: Insufficient material; using a short notice
progress.final_check_degraded.zh: 材料不足，使用简短说明

progress.final_check_fallback.en: Answer format incomplete; using a short notice
progress.final_check_fallback.zh: 答复格式仍不完整，使用简短说明

progress.final_check_rerender.zh: 正在依据材料重写答复

progress.retrieve_graph.empty.zh: 未找到相关内容（关系检索）

progress.retrieve_keyword.empty.zh: 未找到相关内容（关键词检索）

progress.retrieve_semantic.empty.zh: 未找到相关内容（语义检索）

providers.needKey.zh: 请输入有效的 API Key

providers.panelLabel.zh: 模型提供商与自备密钥

providers.subtitle.en: Add your own API key. Keys stay on your channel; the product does not store them in plaintext.
providers.subtitle.zh: 配置您自己的 API Key。自备密钥将直接由本地或私有通道调用，系统绝不明文记录密钥。

referral.bulletBoth.en: When a friend registers with your code and verifies: you both get ¥5 gift credit in the wallet.
referral.bulletBoth.zh: 好友用你的邀请码完成注册并通过验证：你与好友各得 ¥5 赠送金（入余额）。

referral.bulletQuota.en: Invite quota: 5 base + 1 per ¥50 lifetime paid top-up (cash only).
referral.bulletQuota.zh: 邀请次数：基础 5 次；每累计充值 ¥50 现金再 +1 次（仅实付充值计入）。

referral.bulletStack.en: New users still get the ¥20 signup grant; referral stacks on top (invitee up to ¥25 gift face value).
referral.bulletStack.zh: 好友仍享注册礼 ¥20，与邀请奖励叠加（被邀请人合计最高 ¥25 赠送面值）。

referral.bulletWalletOnly.en: Rewards top up wallet balance only — not share slots. Separate from workspace member invites.
referral.bulletWalletOnly.zh: 奖励只加钱包余额，不增加可分享工作区名额；与工作区协作邀请无关。

referral.finePrint.en: Self-invite and abuse are rejected without reward. Rules: product ADR-0010.
referral.finePrint.zh: 自邀与异常设备将被拒绝且不计奖。参数见产品商业模式（ADR-0010）。

referral.hero.en: Share Context-OS with colleagues and friends — you both earn gift credit when they join.
referral.hero.zh: 把知识库带给同事与朋友：他们注册你得奖励，你也帮他们开局。

referral.loadError.en: Could not load your referral code. Try again later.
referral.loadError.zh: 暂时无法加载邀请码，请稍后再试。

referral.modalTitle.zh: 邀请好友 · 双方各得 ¥5

referral.progress.zh: 已成功 {rewarded} / 额度 {quota} · 剩余 {remaining}

settings.appearance.localeDescription.en.en: Useful for cross-team collaboration and external walkthroughs.
settings.appearance.localeDescription.en.zh: 适合跨团队协作或对外演示。

settings.appearance.localeDescription.zh.en: The default language for the current primary audience.
settings.appearance.localeDescription.zh.zh: 面向当前主要用户群的默认语言。

settings.appearance.sectionSubtitle.en: Control how the workspace and admin surfaces look.
settings.appearance.sectionSubtitle.zh: 控制工作台和后台页面的明暗观感。

settings.appearance.themeDescription.dar.en: Reduce glare and emphasize layered work surfaces.
settings.appearance.themeDescription.dar.zh: 降低夜间眩光，强调工作区层次。

settings.appearance.themeDescription.sys.zh: 自动匹配设备当前主题。

settings.billing.byokSubtitle.en: Keys are encrypted at rest. Your main-chat key writes the final answer. Qwen3.7 Flash is the fast model for both document indexing and the retrieval worker; embeddings still debit your balance.
settings.billing.byokSubtitle.zh: 密钥加密存储。自备主对话 Key 只用于最终回答。Qwen3.7 Flash 作为快速模型，同时用于文档索引和检索子代理；向量检索仍从余额扣费。

settings.billing.failedData.en: Some membership data failed to load: {items}
settings.billing.failedData.zh: 部分会员信息加载失败：{items}

settings.billing.payerFundsRequired.en: Balance is empty and no custom provider is configured. Top up or add a provider.
settings.billing.payerFundsRequired.zh: 余额不足，且未配置可用的自定义 Provider。请充值或添加 Provider 后再试。

settings.billing.payerFundsTopUpHint.en: Open Settings → Usage to top up, or configure a custom provider.
settings.billing.payerFundsTopUpHint.zh: 前往设置 → 用量信息充值，或配置自定义 Provider。

settings.billing.planPickerHint.en: Selecting a plan opens the pricing/checkout page to complete the change.
settings.billing.planPickerHint.zh: 选择方案后将进入定价/结账页完成变更。

settings.billing.portalFallbackHint.zh: 请打开定价页，通过 Creem 或支付宝完成支付。

settings.billing.portalUnavailable.en: Self-service payment portal is not available. Try again later, or contact support.
settings.billing.portalUnavailable.zh: 自助支付门户暂未开通。请稍后重试，或联系支持。

settings.billing.referralSubtitle.en: Friends who register with your code earn ¥5 gift credit each.
settings.billing.referralSubtitle.zh: 好友注册填写你的邀请码，双方各得 ¥5 赠送金。

settings.billing.sectionSubtitle.en: Plan tier, share slots, renewal, and balance. Open pricing to change plan.
settings.billing.sectionSubtitle.zh: 档位、分享名额、到期时间与余额一览。更换方案请前往定价页。

settings.billing.walletTopupHint.en: Packs and payment complete under Pricing → Top-up (canonical checkout).
settings.billing.walletTopupHint.zh: 套餐包与支付在定价页「充值」区完成（唯一结账入口）。

settings.billingHint.en: Change plan or top up on the pricing page.
settings.billingHint.zh: 套餐与充值请前往定价页完成。

settings.notifications.emptyBody.en: New system notices and account alerts will appear here.
settings.notifications.emptyBody.zh: 新的系统通知和账户提醒会显示在这里。

settings.notifications.invalidTime.zh: 请使用 24 小时制 HH:MM。

settings.notifications.sectionSubtitle.en: Manage message preferences, digest cadence, and quiet hours.
settings.notifications.sectionSubtitle.zh: 管理消息偏好、摘要频率和免打扰时段。

settings.pageSubtitle.en: Manage usage, profile, appearance, notification, and security settings.
settings.pageSubtitle.zh: 管理用量信息、资料、外观、通知和安全设置。

settings.prefsSubtitle.en: Theme and language apply to this device immediately.
settings.prefsSubtitle.zh: 主题与语言会立即应用到本机界面。

settings.profile.bioPlaceholder.zh: 一句话介绍你自己（可选）

settings.profile.bioTooLong.en: Bio must be at most 500 characters.
settings.profile.bioTooLong.zh: 简介不能超过 500 个字符。

settings.profile.invalidContactUrl.en: Contact link must be an http(s) URL.
settings.profile.invalidContactUrl.zh: 联系链接须为 http(s) URL。

settings.profile.mediaHint.en: JPEG / PNG / WebP / GIF; avatar ≤2MB, banner ≤5MB.
settings.profile.mediaHint.zh: 支持 JPEG / PNG / WebP / GIF；头像 ≤2MB，封面 ≤5MB。

settings.profile.nameTooLong.en: Name must be 120 characters or fewer.
settings.profile.nameTooLong.zh: 姓名长度不能超过 120 个字符。

settings.profile.sectionSubtitle.en: Shown on shared pages as your Owner card: name, bio, avatar, banner, and contact link.
settings.profile.sectionSubtitle.zh: 展示在分享页的个人名片：显示名、简介、头像、封面与联系链接。

settings.profileSaved.zh: 资料已保存到本机会话

settings.security.failed.en: Failed to change the password. Try again later.
settings.security.failed.zh: 修改密码失败，请稍后再试。

settings.security.missingPassword.en: Enter the current password and the new password.
settings.security.missingPassword.zh: 请输入当前密码和新密码。

settings.security.sectionSubtitle.en: Update your password and review account access security.
settings.security.sectionSubtitle.zh: 更新密码并检查账户访问安全。

settings.usage.sectionSubtitle.en: May apply only when balance is empty and no custom provider is set. With balance or a custom provider, chat is no longer subject to these limits.
settings.usage.sectionSubtitle.zh: 仅在无余额且未配置自定义 Provider 时可能触发。有余额或自定义 Provider 后，对话不再受此限制影响。

settingsProvider.type.parseLlm.zh: 文档索引 / 检索子代理

settingsProvider.type.quickChat.en: Quick Chat main model (replaces the primary answer only; parsing, retrieval workers, embedding/rerank and web search stay platform-billed)
settingsProvider.type.quickChat.zh: Quick Chat 主模型（仅替代主回答；文件解析、检索子代理、向量/重排与联网仍按平台计费）

settingsProviderConfiguredFp.zh: 已配置 · {fp}（填新 key 覆盖）

settingsProviderOpenSite.zh: 打开 {name} 官网 / 控制台（新标签）

settingsProviderPartialFp.zh: 部分配置 · {fp}（填 key 补全）

settingsProviderSubtitle.en: Models are fixed. Qwen3.7 Flash is the fast model for both document indexing and the retrieval worker. One API key per row (SiliconFlow embedding and rerank share one key).
settingsProviderSubtitle.zh: 型号固定。Qwen3.7 Flash 作为快速模型，同时用于文档索引和检索子代理。每行只填一把 API Key（SiliconFlow 嵌入与重排共用同一把）。

settingsUpgradeSelectedTier.en: Selected {tier} · pick billing cycle, then pay
settingsUpgradeSelectedTier.zh: 已选 {tier} · 选择计费周期后继续支付

shareAnalyze.emptySubtitle.en: Enable sharing first, then return here for traffic trends and access logs.
shareAnalyze.emptySubtitle.zh: 先在分享页启用分享，再回到这里查看访问趋势和访问日志。

shareAnalyze.emptyTitle.zh: 还没有可分析的分享数据

shareAnalyze.logsSubtitle.zh: 展示最近的分享访问动作。

shareAnalyze.metricsSubtitle.en: Activity ≈ days with visits; totals come from share analytics.
shareAnalyze.metricsSubtitle.zh: 活跃天数≈有访问的天数；总访问量与独立访客来自分享分析。

shareAnalyze.statusSubtitle.en: Share-focused analytics only — not a search or token-cost page.
shareAnalyze.statusSubtitle.zh: 仅保留分享相关分析，不扩展为搜索页或 token 成本页。

shareAnalyze.subtitle.en: Share status, traffic, activity, and recent access for this workspace.
shareAnalyze.subtitle.zh: 当前工作区的分享状态、访问量、活跃与最近访问记录。

shareAnalyze.trendSubtitle.zh: 按日汇总的分享访问量。

shareAnalyze.visitorPrivacyNote.en: Visitor identity is link-based or anonymous network-level — not personal identity.
shareAnalyze.visitorPrivacyNote.zh: 访客身份来自分享链接或匿名网络信息，并非实名，请勿当作个人身份使用。

shareCenter.accessLogsEmptyBody.en: Logs will appear here after public visits occur.
shareCenter.accessLogsEmptyBody.zh: 公开访问发生后，这里会显示访问记录。

shareCenter.accessLogsSectionSubtitle.en: Review recent visitors, access times, and actions.
shareCenter.accessLogsSectionSubtitle.zh: 查看最近访客、访问时间和访问动作。

shareCenter.activityEmptyBody.en: New visits will show up here once people access the shared page.
shareCenter.activityEmptyBody.zh: 一旦有人访问分享页，这里会出现最新记录。

shareCenter.activitySectionSubtitle.en: See the most recent access activity.
shareCenter.activitySectionSubtitle.zh: 查看最近发生的访问行为。

shareCenter.allowDownloadHint.en: When enabled, visitors can download the currently shared sources.
shareCenter.allowDownloadHint.zh: 启用后，访客可下载当前公开资料。

shareCenter.analyticsEmptyBody.en: Trends will appear here once visitors start using the share link.
shareCenter.analyticsEmptyBody.zh: 当访客开始访问共享链接后，这里会显示趋势数据。

shareCenter.analyticsEmptyTitle.zh: 暂时还没有分享访问数据

shareCenter.analyticsSectionSubtitle.en: Review total views, unique visitors, and the daily trend.
shareCenter.analyticsSectionSubtitle.zh: 查看总访问量、独立访客和按天访问趋势。

shareCenter.apiMethodHint.en: API is another way to share: a key is an entry point that opens this workspace's source querying to scripts and agents.
shareCenter.apiMethodHint.zh: API 是另一种分享方法：密钥即入口，把这个工作区的资料查询能力开放给脚本与 agent。

shareCenter.controlBarNoLink.zh: 当前还没有可用的分享链接

shareCenter.controlBarSubtitle.en: Use one control to manage share state and maintain the current link and validity window.
shareCenter.controlBarSubtitle.zh: 用一个开关管理分享状态，并维护当前入口链接和有效期。

shareCenter.desktopPublishHint.en: Not published yet, so sharing stays off. After publish you can create a public link on app.contextlm.top.
shareCenter.desktopPublishHint.zh: 尚未发布到云端，分享开关不可用。发布完成后即可创建 app.contextlm.top 的公开链接。

shareCenter.desktopPublishSubtitle.en: Docs and indexes stay on this machine. Public sharing needs a cloud replica — vectors import directly, without re-parsing.
shareCenter.desktopPublishSubtitle.zh: 本机文档与索引留在本机。对外分享需要一份云端副本；向量直接导入、不重新解析。

shareCenter.diagnosticsDisabledBody.en: Enable sharing to start tracking distribution for this knowledge package.
shareCenter.diagnosticsDisabledBody.zh: 开启分享后，这里会开始追踪这份知识的传播情况。

shareCenter.diagnosticsExpiredBody.en: The link has expired. Historical activity is still available, but you need to regenerate or update sharing to continue distribution.
shareCenter.diagnosticsExpiredBody.zh: 链接已经失效。历史访问仍然保留，但要继续传播需要重新生成或更新分享。

shareCenter.diagnosticsExpiringBody.en: The current share will expire within 3 days. Update the share settings if you want distribution to continue.
shareCenter.diagnosticsExpiringBody.zh: 当前分享将在 3 天内过期。如果你希望继续传播，需要更新分享设置。

shareCenter.diagnosticsHealthyBody.en: Recent visits are still coming in, which suggests this knowledge package is still actively spreading.
shareCenter.diagnosticsHealthyBody.zh: 最近仍有访问，当前这份知识处于持续传播状态。

shareCenter.diagnosticsNotStartedBody.en: This knowledge package is available, but nobody has accessed it yet. You may need to distribute it or make the entry point clearer.
shareCenter.diagnosticsNotStartedBody.zh: 这份知识已经可以访问，但还没有产生访问。可能你还没分发出去，或者入口不够明显。

shareCenter.diagnosticsSectionSubtitle.en: Translate raw access data into next actions.
shareCenter.diagnosticsSectionSubtitle.zh: 把原始访问数据翻译成下一步动作建议。

shareCenter.diagnosticsSpikeBody.en: Visits are concentrated in only a few days, which looks more like a one-off spike than sustained usage.
shareCenter.diagnosticsSpikeBody.zh: 访问集中在少数几天内，传播更像一次性曝光，而不是持续使用。

shareCenter.diagnosticsStalledBody.en: This knowledge package was accessed before, but there have been no visits in the last 7 days. Consider redistributing it or clarifying the share description.
shareCenter.diagnosticsStalledBody.zh: 这份知识曾被访问，但近 7 天没有继续传播。可以考虑重新分发，或优化分享说明。

shareCenter.expiresAtHint.en: Applied only when generating a new share link, for example 2026-04-30T18:00:00Z.
shareCenter.expiresAtHint.zh: 仅在生成新链接时生效，例如 2026-04-30T18:00:00Z。

shareCenter.expiresAtReadOnlyHint.en: To change this expiry, revoke the current link and generate a new one.
shareCenter.expiresAtReadOnlyHint.zh: 当前链接的过期时间需在撤销后重新生成链接时调整。

shareCenter.interactionRuleHint.en: Anyone with the share link can view this knowledge. To control AI cost, users must sign in before asking questions and interacting.
shareCenter.interactionRuleHint.zh: 任何拿到分享链接的人都可以查看这份知识内容。为了控制 AI 成本，登录后才能发起提问和互动。

shareCenter.inviteEmailInvalid.zh: 请输入有效的邮箱地址。

shareCenter.inviteSectionSubtitle.en: Invite collaborators to this workspace and manage their access.
shareCenter.inviteSectionSubtitle.zh: 邀请成员参与当前工作区，并管理他们的访问权限。

shareCenter.loadError.en: Failed to load the share center.

shareCenter.memberLimitWorkspaceNote.en: Signed-in visitor cap is workspace-wide (not per-person).
shareCenter.memberLimitWorkspaceNote.zh: 登录访客上限按工作区统一配置（不是按人单独计算）。

shareCenter.membersEmptyBody.zh: 发送邀请后，成员会显示在这里。

shareCenter.overviewSectionSubtitle.en: Use current telemetry to check whether this knowledge package has started spreading and whether it is still active.
shareCenter.overviewSectionSubtitle.zh: 根据当前数据，判断这份知识是否开始传播、是否仍在传播。

shareCenter.ownerCostConfirmBody.en: Model usage and API costs from visitors on this share are billed to you (the workspace owner)—your credits and keys—not the visitor. Review usage and budget after enabling.
shareCenter.ownerCostConfirmBody.zh: 访客使用分享产生的模型与 API 费用，会从你（工作区所有者）的余额与密钥中扣除，而不是由访客承担。开启后请留意用量与预算。

shareCenter.ownerCostConfirmTitle.zh: 开启分享前请确认费用归属

shareCenter.ownerPaysHint.en: Share Q&A is billed to the workspace owner (balance or custom provider).
shareCenter.ownerPaysHint.zh: 分享问答费用由工作区所有者的余额或自定义 Provider 承担。

shareCenter.ownerProfileHint.en: When on, visitors can tap your avatar on share pages to see your account info and browse all your publicly shared workspaces; when off, these entry points are hidden.
shareCenter.ownerProfileHint.zh: 开启后，访客可以在分享页点击你的头像查看账号信息，并浏览你所有公开分享的工作区；关闭后这些入口会隐藏。

shareCenter.pageSubtitle.en: Publish this workspace as a knowledge package and track how it spreads.
shareCenter.pageSubtitle.zh: 发布当前工作区的知识组合，并追踪它的传播情况。

shareCenter.quotaExceeded.en: You have reached the shareable workspace limit. Disable sharing on another workspace or upgrade your plan.
shareCenter.quotaExceeded.zh: 可分享工作区名额已用尽。请关闭其他工作区的分享，或升级套餐后再试。

shareCenter.readAccessValue.en: Anyone with the link can view

shareCenter.removePendingHint.zh: 确认从当前工作区移除 {name} 吗？

shareCenter.settingsSectionSubtitle.en: Control the share link, interaction rules, download policy, and expiry.
shareCenter.settingsSectionSubtitle.zh: 控制分享入口、互动规则、下载权限和链接有效期。

shareCenter.shareLinkUnavailable.en: There is no active share link right now.
shareCenter.shareLinkUnavailable.zh: 当前没有可用的分享链接。

shareCenter.shareUrlPlaceholder.en: The share link will appear here after it is generated
shareCenter.shareUrlPlaceholder.zh: 生成链接后会显示在这里

shareCenter.trendEmptyBody.en: Once sharing is enabled and people start visiting, the recent trend will appear here.
shareCenter.trendEmptyBody.zh: 开启分享后，这里会显示最近的访问趋势。

shareCenter.trendSectionSubtitle.en: Review the recent rhythm of distribution.
shareCenter.trendSectionSubtitle.zh: 查看这份知识最近的传播节奏。

shareCenter.validityHint.en: Change the validity window, then click "Update share" to generate a new link.
shareCenter.validityHint.zh: 修改有效期后，点击“更新分享”生成新链接即可生效。

shareCenter.visitorModeHint.en: Anonymous link: guests can ask without signing in (capped). Invite / sign-in: only signed-in guests can ask. Model cost is billed to the workspace owner (balance or custom provider).
shareCenter.visitorModeHint.zh: 「匿名链接」：未登录也可提问（按访客限次）。「定向邀请 / 须登录」：仅登录访客可提问。模型费用由工作区所有者的余额或自定义 Provider 承担。

shareConversion.body.en: Plan {plan}: {used}/{max} shared workspaces. Upgrade Plus/Pro for more slots. Guest Q&A on platform models bills the workspace owner; a custom provider skips chat debit, while indexing and the retrieval worker still bill the wallet and count toward usage.
shareConversion.body.zh: 当前 {plan}：已开分享 {used}/{max}。升级 Plus/Pro 可提高可分享工作区数；访客问答若走平台模型，由工作区所有者余额支付（自定义 Provider 不扣对话费；文档索引与检索子代理仍扣余额，并计入用量）。

shareConversion.byokHint.en: Tip: use a custom provider for shared answers (no chat debit; indexing and the retrieval worker still use Qwen3.7 Flash), or keep wallet funded for platform models.
shareConversion.byokHint.zh: 建议：分享场景可先配自定义 Provider（不扣对话费；文档索引与检索子代理仍走 Qwen3.7 Flash），或保持平台模型所需余额。

shareConversion.titleAtCap.en: Share slots full · upgrade or free a slot
shareConversion.titleAtCap.zh: 分享名额已满 · 升级或腾出名额

shareConversion.titleDefault.en: More share slots unlock with higher plans
shareConversion.titleDefault.zh: 多分享一个库，需要更高档位

shareConversion.upgradeCta.zh: 升级会员 · 更多分享名额

shareInviteSendHint.en: We'll try email (SMTP required); you can also copy the share page link.
shareInviteSendHint.zh: 将尝试发送邀请邮件（需配置 SMTP）；也可手动转发分享页链接。

sharedPublic.browseOnlyBody.en: Workspace-like layout: sessions, chat, and sources. Capabilities locked to RAG (no plain chat mode, no web search). Sources and notes cannot be added.
sharedPublic.browseOnlyBody.zh: 布局与工作区一致：左侧会话、中间对话、右侧资料。能力固定为 RAG（无 chat 模式、无联网检索）；不可添加内容源与笔记。

sharedPublic.chatSectionSubtitle.en: Viewing does not require sign-in. Asking questions does.
sharedPublic.chatSectionSubtitle.zh: 查看内容无需登录，登录后才能发起问答。

sharedPublic.invalidLinkBody.en: This share link is invalid, revoked, or expired.
sharedPublic.invalidLinkBody.zh: 这个共享链接无效、已撤销，或已经过期。

sharedPublic.inviteAuthHint.en: Sign in or register before handling this invite.
sharedPublic.inviteAuthHint.zh: 需要先登录或注册，才能处理这条邀请。

sharedPublic.inviteGenericBody.en: You are invited to a workspace. Sign in to accept or decline.
sharedPublic.inviteGenericBody.zh: 你被邀请加入一个工作区。登录后可接受或拒绝。

sharedPublic.inviteSubtitle.en: Sign in to accept or decline this workspace invite.
sharedPublic.inviteSubtitle.zh: 登录后可接受或拒绝这条工作区邀请。

sharedPublic.moreSharesEmpty.en: This sharer has no other public shared workspaces yet.
sharedPublic.moreSharesEmpty.zh: 这位分享者暂时没有其他公开共享的工作区。

sharedPublic.moreSharesLoading.zh: 正在加载分享者的其他共享…

sharedPublic.openOwnerProfile.en: View sharer profile and all shared workspaces
sharedPublic.openOwnerProfile.zh: 查看分享者主页与全部共享库

sharedPublic.pageSubtitle.en: Shared knowledge base: chat in RAG mode with sessions. No adding sources, notes, or web search.
sharedPublic.pageSubtitle.zh: 共享知识库：可对话（默认 RAG）、可管理会话。不可添加资料、笔记或联网检索。

sharedPublic.profileHint.zh: 点击头像查看全部共享

sharedPublic.profileNotFound.en: This sharer profile was not found.

sharedPublic.profileSharesEmpty.zh: 暂时没有可打开的共享工作区。

sharedPublic.ragLockedHint.en: Share page is locked to knowledge-base RAG — no plain chat or web search.
sharedPublic.ragLockedHint.zh: 分享页固定为知识库 RAG，不可切换到 chat 或联网检索。

sharedPublic.readAccessValue.en: Anyone with the link can view

sharedPublic.signInRequiredBody.en: Viewing does not require sign-in. To control AI cost, only signed-in users can ask questions and interact.
sharedPublic.signInRequiredBody.zh: 查看内容无需登录。为了控制 AI 成本，只有登录用户才能发起提问和互动。

sharedPublic.sourceAskTemplate.zh: 请总结一下《{name}》的主要内容。

sharedPublic.sourceDetailBody.en: Visitor share pages list sources and status. Full body preview and download still follow the share policy set by the owner.
sharedPublic.sourceDetailBody.zh: 访客分享页仅展示资料清单与状态。正文预览与下载仍受分享策略与所有者配置限制。

sharedPublic.sourcesEmptyBody.en: Sharing is enabled, but there are no publicly visible sources yet.
sharedPublic.sourcesEmptyBody.zh: 共享已开启，但当前没有可公开浏览的资料。

sharedPublic.sourcesSectionSubtitle.en: The list of publicly visible sources and their current status.
sharedPublic.sourcesSectionSubtitle.zh: 当前公开可见的资料列表和状态。

sharedPublic.sourcesTabEmpty.en: This shared workspace has no sources yet.
sharedPublic.sourcesTabEmpty.zh: 这个共享工作区暂时没有资料。

sharedPublic.turnstileRequired.en: Complete the human verification before asking.
sharedPublic.turnstileRequired.zh: 请先完成人机验证再提问。

sharedPublicVerifyHint.en: Complete the human verification challenge before asking.
sharedPublicVerifyHint.zh: 请先完成人机验证后再提问。

toastUpgradeCta.en: Upgrade plan or top up balance →

upgradeModal.memberBody.en: Membership unlocks shareable workspace slots (Free 3 / Plus 10 / Pro 100). Client and private workspaces stay free.
upgradeModal.memberBody.zh: 会员解锁可分享工作区名额（Free 3 / Plus 10 / Pro 100）。客户端与仅自己使用的工作区始终免费。

upgradeModal.subtitle.en: This dialog explains the product. Complete payment or top-up on the pricing or billing page.
upgradeModal.subtitle.zh: 本页是产品说明。正式支付与充值请进入定价页或账单页完成。

upgradeModal.topupBody.en: Wallet pays platform model calls and retrieval. Independent of plan — top up only, upgrade only, or both.
upgradeModal.topupBody.zh: 余额支付平台模型调用与向量检索。与会员独立：可以只充值不升级，也可以两者都要。

upgradeModal.topupStrip.en: Ready to pay? Open pricing for tiers or wallet top-up packs.
upgradeModal.topupStrip.zh: 需要立刻支付？请到定价页选档或直接充值余额。

upgradeSuccess.subtitle.en: Thanks — your plan or wallet credit is now active.
upgradeSuccess.subtitle.zh: 感谢您对 Context-OS 的支持，您的会员权益或充值金额已到账。

upgradeSuccessSubtitle.en: Your new plan is active. Enjoy!
upgradeSuccessSubtitle.zh: 新档位已立即生效，祝你用得开心。

usageErrorLoad.en: Failed to load usage data. Please try again later.
usageErrorLoad.zh: 消费数据加载失败，请稍后重试。

usageFreeUpgradeHint.en: → Upgrade Plus/Pro for more shareable workspaces
usageFreeUpgradeHint.zh: → 升级 Plus/Pro 增加可分享工作区名额

usageMarginNote.en: Reference multiplier M={m}; with a custom provider, chat can skip platform balance.
usageMarginNote.zh: 参考计费乘数 M={m}；配置自定义 Provider 后，对话可不消耗平台余额。

usageSoftLimitWarning.en: Approaching protective throttle — check balance or custom provider
usageSoftLimitWarning.zh: 接近平台保护限速，建议检查余额或自定义 Provider。

workbench.sourcesEmpty.en: No sources yet. Upload a file, paste a link, or paste text.
workbench.sourcesEmpty.zh: 还没有资料。可上传文件、粘贴链接或文本。

workspaceChatHeroSubtitle.en: Ask directly — select documents on the right and answers will search them.
workspaceChatHeroSubtitle.zh: 直接提问；选中右侧文档后，回答会检索这些文档。

workspaceChatHeroTitle.en: What would you like to ask?

workspaceChatLoadError.zh: 加载工作区对话记录失败。

workspaceChatModeLineBoth.en: Knowledge base + Web search: answers search selected documents and the web.
workspaceChatModeLineBoth.zh: 知识库 + 网络搜索：回答检索已选文档与网页。

workspaceChatModeLineChat.en: Chat: answers do not search documents or the web.
workspaceChatModeLineChat.zh: 聊天：回答不检索文档与网络。

workspaceChatModeLineNoSelection.en: No documents selected — select documents on the right to enable knowledge retrieval.
workspaceChatModeLineNoSelection.zh: 未选择文档：可选择右侧文档后开启知识库检索。

workspaceChatModeLineRag.en: Knowledge base: answers search the selected documents.
workspaceChatModeLineRag.zh: 知识库：回答检索已选文档。

workspaceChatModeLineSearch.en: Web search: answers search the web.
workspaceChatModeLineSearch.zh: 网络搜索：回答会检索网页。

workspaceCitation.empty.en: This citation does not include displayable text.
workspaceCitation.empty.zh: 当前引用没有可展示的文本内容。

workspaceDeleteSessionDialogBody.zh: 确定删除会话「{title}」吗？此操作无法撤销。

workspaceDeleteSessionFailed.en: Failed to delete the session. Please try again.

workspaceGuardIntervened.zh: 安全护栏已介入当前回答。

workspaceNoteLinkPlaceholder.en: Paste or enter a link URL

workspaceRenameSessionFailed.en: Failed to rename the session. Please try again.
workspaceRenameSessionFailed.zh: 重命名会话失败，请重试。

workspaceRightRail.addSourceSubtitle.en: Add a file, web link, or pasted content to this workspace.
workspaceRightRail.addSourceSubtitle.zh: 选择文件、网页链接或粘贴内容来扩展当前工作区。

workspaceRightRail.emptyNotesBody.en: Capture key conclusions, decisions, and action items here.
workspaceRightRail.emptyNotesBody.zh: 把关键结论、决策和行动项记录到这里。

workspaceRightRail.emptySourcesBody.en: Uploaded files and imported URLs will appear here.
workspaceRightRail.emptySourcesBody.zh: 上传文件或添加 URL 后，资料会出现在这里。

workspaceRightRail.notesSectionSubtitle.en: Capture conclusions, drafts, and next actions for the workspace.
workspaceRightRail.notesSectionSubtitle.zh: 记录工作区结论、草稿和后续行动。

workspaceRightRail.promoteNoteEmptyError.en: Cannot convert an empty note into a source.
workspaceRightRail.promoteNoteEmptyError.zh: 笔记为空，无法转换为来源。

workspaceRightRail.promoteNoteError.en: Failed to convert note to source.

workspaceRightRail.selectNoteToEdit.en: Select a note to edit it in place.
workspaceRightRail.selectNoteToEdit.zh: 选择一条笔记后可在此直接编辑。

workspaceRightRail.sourceUrlPlaceholder.zh: 每行输入一个 URL，支持直接粘贴多行链接

workspaceRightRail.sourcesSectionSubtitl.en: Manage retrievable sources, URL imports, and document status.
workspaceRightRail.sourcesSectionSubtitl.zh: 管理可检索资料、URL 导入和文档状态。

workspaceRightRail.viewerEmptyBody.en: Choose a source from the list or a citation card to preview it here.
workspaceRightRail.viewerEmptyBody.zh: 从资料列表或引用卡片中选中一个条目后，这里会显示预览。

workspaceRightRail.viewerSectionSubtitle.en: Inspect source excerpts, citations, and raw content.
workspaceRightRail.viewerSectionSubtitle.zh: 查看资料片段、引用内容和原始文本。

workspaceSearchEmptyIdle.en: Type a keyword to search sessions and chat content.
workspaceSearchEmptyIdle.zh: 输入关键词后即可搜索会话和聊天正文。

workspaceSearchLoadError.en: Some session content could not be loaded, so results may be incomplete.
workspaceSearchLoadError.zh: 部分会话内容加载失败，搜索结果可能不完整。

workspaceSearchPlaceholder.zh: 输入关键词搜索聊天正文

workspaceUnavailableBody.en: This workspace id is not present in the current backend database. Sending messages here will only fail. Check that you are connected to the expected API/database, or create a new workspace.
workspaceUnavailableBody.zh: 这个页面的 workspace id 当前不在后端数据库里，继续发送消息只会返回错误。请确认你连接的是正确的 API/数据库，或者重新创建一个工作区。

share.challengeRequired.en: Complete the verification before sending. If it cannot load, reload this page or sign in.
share.challengeRequired.zh: 完成验证后即可发送；若验证无法加载，请刷新页面或登录后提问。
